notes: Sam's Club app has an 'Add to Apple Wallet' option for the membership card barcode. Many users report errors during the process; reliability is inconsistent.
knownIssues: Many users report errors when attempting to add membership card to Apple Wallet

sources.note: Apple Community thread: widespread errors adding Sam's Club card to Apple Wallet (95+ 'Me too' responses)
Sam's Club help: digital membership card available in app; Add to Apple Wallet option confirmed via app Account section
Apple Community thread (2026): Add to Apple Wallet for Sam's Club still available in app but reliability remains inconsistent; some users report feature unavailable or broken
